script.spoken: Everyone aboard was killed. Everyone aboard was killed, along with one person on the ground. As the plane slowed, its stall warning shook the controls. The right response was to push the nose down. The captain pulled back instead. That deepened the stall until recovery was impossible. Both pilots had been tired. US rules on pilot training and rest were then overhauled.
